items.headline: Air India appoints Tewolde Gebremariam as CEO and Managing Director
items.summary: Air India’s board appointed former Ethiopian Airlines Group chief Tewolde Gebremariam to succeed Campbell Wilson. The airline said the exact onboarding and transition schedule will be announced separately.

items.headline: Air India adds Mumbai–Toronto service and deploys a new 787-9 to Toronto
items.summary: Air India announced a seasonal three-times-weekly Mumbai–Toronto route for winter 2026–27 and began using its new Boeing 787-9 on Delhi–Toronto flights.

items.headline: Air India, SkyDrive and Suzuki study eVTOL medical logistics in India
items.summary: The three companies signed an MoU to assess using electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft for medical air logistics in India.

items.headline: India launches international hub-and-spoke operations from Amritsar
items.summary: The Ministry of Civil Aviation inaugurated international hub-and-spoke operations from Amritsar, allowing through check-in and baggage connections via Delhi.

items.headline: IndiGo and CFM sign MoU covering more than 1,000 LEAP-1A engines
items.summary: The proposed agreement covers engines for 510 Airbus A320neo-family aircraft and support for IndiGo’s planned engine maintenance facility.

items.headline: Alliance Air begins the first direct scheduled air link between Daman and Delhi
items.summary: Alliance Air launched the Daman–Delhi service from the newly operational NAMO Airport.

items.headline: Akasa Air maintains a 30% capacity-growth target for FY27
items.summary: Akasa Air said it was retaining its growth plan despite geopolitical and fuel-cost pressure. The airline reported a fleet of 39 Boeing 737 MAX aircraft.

items.headline: EASA updates Safety Information Bulletin on GNSS interference
items.summary: EASA updated its safety guidance concerning interference with global navigation satellite systems.

items.headline: EASA assesses socio-economic factors affecting aviation safety
items.summary: EASA published its second Article 89 report examining safety and socio-economic factors affecting safety-critical personnel.

items.headline: NTSB expands its civil aviation accident dashboard with findings data
items.summary: The NTSB enhanced its public civil aviation accident dashboard to include findings data.
